Benidorm

Sunday 17 January 2027

In mid-January, the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup swaps mud for sun and sand. On Sunday 17 January, the riders will battle for the win in Benidorm, Spain. Last year, Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel raced to victory on the Costa Blanca. Who will be the fastest under the Spanish sun this year?

Tickets

Would you like to be there in Benidorm on Sunday 17 January? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Practical information

Address

Avinguda 9 d'Octubre 03502, Benidorm

 

Website local organisation

Visit the website of the local organisation [here](https://benidormcx.es/).

 

Do you have a question?

Contact the organisation [here](https://www.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/en/contact).

How to get there?

By train

Take the Tram Metropolità d'Alacant. Line 1 takes you from Alicante to Benidorm Station. From there, it's just a few hundred metres' walk to the course. Line 9 runs from Dénia to Benidorm Intermodal, which is about 1.5 km from the course. You can find more information [here](https://www.tramalacant.es/).

 

By car

Parking is available at one of Benidorm's free car parks. You can find more information [here](https://benidorm.org/es/ayuntamiento/concejalias/movilidad-y-trafico/aparcamientos-gratuitos).
